data.one_liner: Authentication server module for Serverpod backend applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides server-side authentication capabilities for the Serverpod app server. It handles social accounts, OAuth, and passwordless OTP login.
use_when: You are building a backend using Serverpod and need authentication features.
You require features like passwordless OTP login or OAuth on your Serverpod backend.
avoid_when: You are not using Serverpod as your backend architecture.
You need a purely client-side authentication solution.
strengths: Integrated directly into the Serverpod ecosystem.
Supports modern authentication methods like passwordless OTP login.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Serverpod framework.
Not documented thoroughly outside of the core Serverpod docs.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up a Serverpod backend project and configuring server-side modules.
